decision.reason: [ev-070e2e78535d] lists `cilium_triggers_policy_update_folds` under "Removed Metrics" and says it has been removed, so the change type "removed" is supported. The subject is the problem: this is a Prometheus metric, not wire or protocol behaviour, so the protocol-behavior family is the wrong fit. The underscore name also breaks the kebab-case rule for free-form names. None of the allowed subject families describes a metric, so I can't write a correct subject. This needs a decision on the taxonomy, not more evidence.
